## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (90%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Invasive carcinoma (8%) remains in the conformal set [F1], and low reliability flags an atypical image [F6].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 90%, Invasive 8%, Benign 2%, Normal 0% | Favors InSitu; low invasive risk |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (10% alpha; 90% coverage) | Cannot exclude invasive carcinoma |
| Reliability / OOD | 30% reliability (flagged); 98th percentile OOD | Atypical input; reduced model trust |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class (false) | Independent foundation models split |
| Similar cases | 40% match (2/5 InSitu, 2/5 Invasive, 1/5 Benign) [F5] | Nearest reference neighbors are mixed |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 4) · context · Scarce TILs (+0.495 push toward invasive) [F2]; 8/20 AI spot check · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.275 push) [F3], but 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Typical score (-0.233 push away from invasive) [F4]; 19/20 spot check · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 5, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · High score (+0.226 push), but 3/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Tumor cell fraction and density** (regions 6, 7, 11) · context · 94% neoplastic nuclei [F7], 5,889/mm² [F8] (100th percentile), 0% immune [F9] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability more than random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.0008 vs random, 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064); leans on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20), and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions 6, 7, and 11 (risks 54%, 45%, 31%) harbor invasion, matching top neighbor BACH_0138 (Invasive).
- Out-of-distribution quality (98th percentile OOD, 30% reliability) distorted features, requiring drafted recut, deeper levels, or p63/calponin stains.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 7, 11**: Highest risk (54%, 45%, 31%) and dense tumor; verify myoepithelium (drafted p63, calponin, ER).
2. **Regions 5, 10, 11**: Confirm duct confinement in region 10 and check Unreliable necrosis calls (3/20 spot check).
3. **Regions 0, 4, 8**: Inspect region 0 stroma, region 4 TILs, and region 8 quality (drafted recut/deeper levels).
